glosses: происходящий или производимый только один раз, сразу

examples.text: Некоторые авторы отмечают для миноги моноцикличный характер размножения с единовременным нерестом.

glosses: устар. происходящий или производимый в одно время с чем-либо; одновременный

examples.text: In accounting, nonrecurring items are exceptional transactions that are not related to normal business operations. The most common nonrecurring items are capital gains, additional write-downs or reversals of write-downs, and provisions for planned restructuring and penalties.

glosses: Of or pertaining to a specific period of time in the past, not extending to the present.

examples.text: He was the one-time president of the club.
His one-time investment in a brickyard had put the idea into his head—an idea that he decided was a good one, for it enabled him to suggest that she ride along with him to inspect the quarry.
Pollyanna never doubted now that John Pendleton was her Aunt Polly's one-time lover; […]
The old Ramsgate Harbour station of the one-time South Eastern Railway was a case in point, as also the stations in the Isle of Wight that you name, such as Ventnor West.
Has the one-time wonder fuel become the new asbestos – not to say mustard gas?

glosses: Occurring or used in a single instance and then never again.

examples.text: He was an eloquent speaker, and his slip of the tongue was a one-time error.
Even if an attacker manages to intercept a one-time password, that password has already been used and is no longer usable to authenticate.

glosses: To shoot (the ball or puck) directly from a teammate's pass.

examples.text: Basel's good moment continued, and in stoppage time of the first half, Streller released Salah with a clever pass down the middle and the young Egyptian one-timed the ball over Čech.
